422.h: Maryam Abacha American University of Nigeria (MAAUN) is a private university founded in April 2021 by Professor Adamu Abubakar Gwarzo, who wanted to widen access to good-quality university education. It is fully licensed and accredited by the National Universities Commission.
422.a: MAAUN runs 22 undergraduate programmes in five schools: Computing, Health Sciences, Nursing Sciences, Law, and Social and Management Sciences. Health programmes include medical laboratory science and a doctor of physiotherapy degree, and the programmes include work experience and multicultural exposure.

427.h: Anan University is a private university owned by the Association of National Accountants of Nigeria (ANAN), which also runs the Nigerian College of Accountancy, founded in 1994 in Barkin Ladi, Plateau State, to train certified national accountants. ANAN appointed a planning and implementation committee of academics and professionals to establish the university, and the National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
427.a: The university specialises in accountancy and allied subjects, with a strong emphasis on postgraduate education in the field.
427.c: It is located at Kwall, in Plateau State.

430.h: Margaret Lawrence University (MLU) is a private university established to raise a new generation of leaders through academic training combined with character development. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
430.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes; law, business and technology are taught at its Abuja campus.
430.c: MLU has two campuses: its main campus at Galilee, near Umunede in Ika North-East, Delta State, and a second campus in the River Park Estate at Lugbe, Abuja.

437.h: Newgate University, Minna (NUM) was approved by the Federal Executive Council in May 2022 as the first private university in Minna. Its Faculty of Law building was commissioned on 22 December 2023. In August 2025 it received a full operating licence from the National Universities Commission and joined the Nigerian University Games Association, and in December 2025 it held its first convocation, graduating 207 students, 14 of them with first-class honours.
437.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes, including law, and has begun postgraduate studies.
437.c: It is located in Minna, the capital of Niger State.

439.h: NorthWest University, Sokoto (NWUS) is a private university licensed by the National Universities Commission in May 2022, to widen access to higher education in north-western Nigeria.
439.a: NWUS offers accredited programmes across several faculties and a College of Health Sciences, including medicine and surgery, nursing, law, computing, management and social sciences, and education.
439.c: It is located at Kalambaina Industrial Layout in Wamakko local government area, Sokoto State.

457.h: Phoenix University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023. It was founded on 45 hectares of land donated by its founder at Agwada, the founder's ancestral home.
457.a: The university aims to combine academic study with practical relevance, and to build research links that benefit the surrounding community.
457.c: It is located at Agwada, Nasarawa State.

459.h: Hillside University of Science and Technology (HUST) is a Federal Government-approved private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023. It aims to provide affordable, good-quality education in science, technology, engineering, mathematics and management.
459.a: The university's programmes focus on STEM subjects and management, with an emphasis on technological innovation and preparing graduates for the modern workforce.
459.c: It is located in the town of Okemesi, Ekiti State.
